section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Installation of Component Parts
ocr_text:
31. INSTALL ACCUMULATOR SPRINGS, PISTONS AND PINS
(a) Coat new O-rings with ATF and install them to the pistons.
(b) Install the four springs and four accumulator pistons to the bore as shown in the figure.
HINT: The pistons are marked in relief with either C₀, B₀, C₂ or B₂ to the discriminate between them.

(c) Install the two springs to the C₄ accumulator piston.
